findings.detail: Fresh lifecycle.verify_candidate(bundle, 'candidates/initial') passed. All 30 evidence/normalization records match admitted inputs and registered scoped extracts; analytic input/operator/script hashes and frozen auxiliary artifacts agree. Freeze and decision bytes remained unchanged.

The code matches independent standardized beta/uniform primitives and the stated affine biomarker equations. Nested loops guarantee exactly 375 rows in each of eight sex-by-age-band cells, 3000 total. Independent primitive-corner bounds give BMI 19.1656970338 to 44.8357574155, glucose 67.7724370617 to 123.0724231854 mg/dL, and target HbA1c 4.5419062467 to 6.7189274502 percent, satisfying task support without clipping or rejection.

Independent 2x2 inversion derives joint BMI/glucose coefficients 0.004646330742428303 and 0.011003290354090355 from the two distinct Jansen projections with assumed rho=0.30. NGSP slope scaling and glucose predictor conversion are correct and use no affine offset. Residual variance 0.06889732901983824 is positive and matches the specified residual SD.

Direct affine covariance identities reproduce all target-design, Lifelines and Pani means/covariances/second moments. Independent Cholesky solves reproduce the separate Jansen BMI slope 0.0118924, separate glucose slope 0.01163828888888889 and fully adjusted Pani age slope 0.01 in their declared contexts. Their agreement is imposed under assumptions, not independent validation.

Target and Lifelines primitive laws are bounded. Pani >=70 uses 70 plus geometric failures with p=0.1, without a target-derived upper cap; its finite polynomial moments and affine HbA1c law establish required source moments. Positive residual variance and nondegenerate primitive covariances give full population rank. The remote age tail is explicitly a modeling limitation.

All 11 operations have correct source/evidence mapping, uncertainty/overlap/selection assumptions and reachable frozen artifact pointers: three model constraints and eight analytic checks. Independent conditional numerator/denominator calculations reproduce Pani mean differences of +0.165, +0.185, +0.145, +0.165, +0.175, +0.205, +0.215 and +0.325 percentage points. All 101 checks passed; no favorable-fit criterion or SE-based tolerance was used.

All 29 quantitative target-as-source comparisons are not_computable with null operators and hash-bound unsupported semantic declarations. The remaining NGSP record is contextual guidance. Analytic source scenarios are not represented as target-table replay or complex-survey reconstruction.

BMI/glucose correlation, age/sex independence, absent extra sex effect, bounded factor shapes, source-context age laws and cross-population/assay transfer remain explicit assumptions. Pani age-specific levels disagree with the common equation and are retained. Source SEs remain estimator uncertainty, unknown Jansen CI levels are not turned into SEs, and duplicate representations are not independent evidence.

No generator/author script import or execution, participant rows, numerical quadrature, clinical target reference, unassigned candidate or old experiment was used. Endpoint combinations are algebraic support extrema only. Runtime table validity remains for isolated final execution. Review did not close science, consume trials or deliver seeds.
